# unifi_hotspot2_conf (Data Source)

The `unifi_hotspot2_conf` data source retrieves an existing Passpoint / Hotspot 2.0 configuration profile by `name` or `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing Passpoint / Hotspot 2.0 configuration profile by name.
data "unifi_hotspot2_conf" "example" {
  name = "example-passpoint"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the profile to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be set.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `anqp_domain_id` (Number) The ANQP domain identifier.
- `capab` (Attributes List) The ANQP IP-connectivity capability list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capab))
- `cellular_network_list` (Attributes List) The 3GPP cellular network list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cellular_network_list))
- `deauth_req_timeout` (Number) The deauthentication request timeout, in seconds.
- `disable_dgaf` (Boolean) Whether DGAF is disabled.
- `domain_name_list` (List of String) The list of domain names advertised in the ANQP domain-name element.
- `friendly_name` (Attributes List) The operator friendly names, one per language. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--friendly_name))
- `gas_advanced` (Boolean) Whether advanced GAS configuration is enabled.
- `gas_comeback_delay` (Number) The GAS comeback delay, in TUs.
- `gas_frag_limit` (Number) The GAS response fragmentation limit, in bytes.
- `hessid` (String) The homogeneous ESS identifier (HESSID).
- `hessid_used` (Boolean) Whether the HESSID is advertised.
- `icons` (Attributes List) The operator icons. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icons))
